issue_request: FHIR-12548 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Search change request asking that _summary=text explicitly include Resource.id, since the previous wording listed text, meta, and mandatory elements while Resource.id is optional.
initial_application: The issue was applied by git-svn commit 68a24d7d2a27803384a959490f071c6e8fdd6357, matching the Jira comment that svn @11019 updated the _summary=text definition to include the id element. No prior Issue-Reconcile-Key commit for FHIR-12548 was present on the combined branch.
additional_context: source/search.html remains active build-scope narrative source: source/hierarchy.xml lists search.html as the Search page and source/fhir.ini notes that search-rules changes require updating the search.html summary table. FHIR-33002 later clarified the same table's top-level mandatory element behavior while preserving id. The January 2017 Zulip #implementers resource ids thread supports the same conclusion, and Confluence searches found no conflicting references.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current source/search.html _summary=text row already includes id, so the current specification satisfies the Jira request.
